query: SELECT Med_drug.recommended_usage, Med_disease.preventive_measures, Med_drug.unsuitable_population, Med_disease.disease_type FROM disease JOIN drug ON disease.disease_name = drug.disease_name WHERE (Med_drug.dosage_frequency != '2 or 3 times daily' AND Med_disease.sequelae != 'disability') OR (Med_disease.epidemiology != 'especially amongst young men and women' AND Med_drug.active_ingredients = 'Clomiphene');
note: SQL本身只有结构化算子；SExtract是从原文到关系的分析性补充，不是源SQL的显式调用，也不表明每个字段必须由LLM抽取。字段类型、NULL及一对多抽取契约须在执行前固定。 源SQL存在未绑定表限定符：Med_disease, Med_drug；图原样保留，字段归属待核，不能直接执行。所需字段：Med_disease.disease_type, Med_disease.epidemiology, Med_disease.preventive_measures, Med_disease.sequelae, Med_drug.active_ingredients, Med_drug.dosage_frequency, Med_drug.recommended_usage, Med_drug.unsuitable_population, disease.disease_name, drug.disease_name
